# Shippo MCP connector

Let your AI handle shipping through Shippo: validate addresses, compare live rates from your carriers, buy and refund labels, track parcels, prepare customs paperwork and create scan forms. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 30 MCP tools for Shippo: 21 read and 9 can change data.

[![Open Shippo in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dshippo&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=shippo)

**Category:** [Logistics](../logistics.md) · **Tools:** 30 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/shippo-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/shippo-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/shippo-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/shippo-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/shippo-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/shippo-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/shippo-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Shippo connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Shippo connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Shippo account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/shippo-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-shippo-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-shippo-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-shippo-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-shippo-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-shippo-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-shippo-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *What's the tracking status for carrier shippo and tracking number SHIPPO_TRANSIT for invoice INV-2026-078?*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Shippo API<br/>api.goshippo.com"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, an API key" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Shippo credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (an API key), calls Shippo, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Shippo** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/shippo.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/shippo.json).

### `shippo_create_address`

Save an address, optionally validated. Returns the address with object_id (usable in shipments instead of the full address), is_complete and, with validate true, validation_results.is_valid and messages.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /addresses`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Full name of the person. |
| `company` | string | no | Company name. |
| `street1` | string | no | Street and house number. |
| `street2` | string | no | Second address line. |
| `street_no` | string | no | House number, if the carrier wants it separate (some EU carriers). |
| `city` | string | no | City. |
| `state` | string | no | State or province code (required for US, CA and some other countries). |
| `zip` | string | no | Postal code. |
| `country` | string | yes | ISO 3166 two-letter country code, e.g. "DE" or "US". |
| `phone` | string | no | Phone number (many carriers require it for the recipient). |
| `email` | string | no | Email address. |
| `is_residential` | boolean | no | true for a private home, false for a business. |
| `validate` | boolean | no | true to validate the address while saving it; the answer then has validation_results. |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note, up to 100 characters. |

### `shippo_get_address`

Read a saved address by object_id, with its fields, completeness and any validation results.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /addresses/{address_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address_id` | string | yes | The address object_id. |

### `shippo_validate_address`

Validate a saved address. Shippo answers with a new saved address that has its own object_id, the standardized fields (for example the ZIP+4 code) and validation_results (is_valid, messages with suggested corrections); the original address stays as it was. Use the new object_id in shipments. With a test key, non-US addresses are not checked.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /addresses/{address_id}/validate`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address_id` | string | yes | The address object_id. |

### `shippo_list_addresses`

List saved addresses, newest first, with next and previous page links.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /addresses`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `results` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 100. |

### `shippo_create_parcel`

Save a parcel (dimensions and weight, or a carrier parcel template plus weight). Returns object_id, usable in shipments.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /parcels`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `length` | string | no | Length, e.g. "30". |
| `width` | string | no | Width. |
| `height` | string | no | Height. |
| `distance_unit` | `cm` \| `in` \| `ft` \| `m` \| `mm` \| `yd` | no | cm, in, ft, m, mm or yd. |
| `weight` | string | yes | Weight, e.g. "1.2". |
| `mass_unit` | `g` \| `kg` \| `lb` \| `oz` | yes | g, kg, lb or oz. |
| `template` | string | no | A carrier parcel template token instead of dimensions, e.g. "USPS_FlatRateEnvelope" (see shippo_list_parcel_templates). |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note, up to 100 characters. |

### `shippo_get_parcel`

Read a saved parcel by object_id: dimensions, weight, units and template.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /parcels/{parcel_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parcel_id` | string | yes | The parcel object_id. |

### `shippo_list_parcel_templates`

List carrier parcel templates (flat rate boxes and envelopes): token, name, carrier and dimensions.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /parcel-templates`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `carrier` | string | no | Only templates of this carrier, e.g. "usps", "fedex", "ups". |
| `include` | `all` \| `user` \| `enabled` | no | all, user or enabled. |

### `shippo_create_shipment`

Create a shipment and get live rates from the account's carriers. Nothing is bought. Returns object_id, status and rates[] (object_id, amount, currency, provider, servicelevel, estimated_days, attributes such as CHEAPEST and FASTEST).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /shipments`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address_from` | any | yes | An address object {"name", "company", "street1", "street2", "city", "state", "zip", "country" (ISO 2), "phone", "email"} or the object_id of a saved address. |
| `address_to` | any | yes | An address object {"name", "company", "street1", "street2", "city", "state", "zip", "country" (ISO 2), "phone", "email"} or the object_id of a saved address. |
| `parcels` | any[] | yes | Parcels: objects {"length", "width", "height", "distance_unit", "weight", "mass_unit"} or parcel object_ids. |
| `address_return` | any | no | Optional return address (object or object_id). |
| `customs_declaration` | string | no | object_id of a customs declaration, required for international shipments. |
| `extra` | object | no | Optional services, e.g. {"signature_confirmation": "STANDARD", "insurance": {"amount": "200", "currency": "EUR", "content": "Books"}, "reference_1": "Order 1042", "is_return": false}. |
| `shipment_date` | string | no | Planned ship date, ISO 8601 (default now). |
| `carrier_accounts` | string[] | no | Only rates from these carrier account object_ids. |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note, up to 100 characters. |
| `async` | boolean | no | false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again. |

Read a shipment with its addresses, parcels, rates and messages.

### `shippo_buy_label`

Buy a shipping label for a rate. With a live key this charges the label price to the Shippo account immediately: confirm carrier, service, price and addresses with the user first. Returns the transaction with status, tracking_number, tracking_url_provider and label_url (expiring link to the label file).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /transactions`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rate` | string | yes | The object_id of the chosen rate. |
| `label_file_type` | `PDF` \| `PDF_4x6` \| `PDF_4x8` \| `PDF_A4` \| `PDF_A5` \| `PDF_A6` \| `PDF_2.3x7.5` \| `PNG` \| `PNG_2.3x7.5` \| `ZPLII` | no | PDF, PDF_4x6, PDF_4x8, PDF_A4, PDF_A5, PDF_A6, PDF_2.3x7.5, PNG, PNG_2.3x7.5 or ZPLII; the account default when omitted. |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note, e.g. an order number, up to 100 characters. |
| `async` | boolean | no | false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again. |

### `shippo_list_labels`

List purchased labels (transactions), newest first, with status, tracking number and tracking status.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /transactions`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object_status` | string | no | SUCCESS, ERROR, QUEUED, WAITING, REFUNDED, REFUNDPENDING or REFUNDREJECTED. |
| `tracking_status` | string | no | UNKNOWN, PRE_TRANSIT, TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED or FAILURE. |
| `rate` | string | no | Only the label bought for this rate object_id. |
| `object_created_gte` | string | no | Created at or after, ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `object_created_lte` | string | no | Created at or before, ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `results` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 100. |

### `shippo_get_label`

Read one purchased label (transaction): status, tracking number and status, ETA, a fresh label_url and commercial invoice URL, and messages.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /transactions/{transaction_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | string | yes | The transaction object_id. |

### `shippo_get_tracking`

Read the tracking status and history of a parcel by carrier and tracking number, for labels bought anywhere. Returns tracking_status (status, details, time, location), tracking_history[] and eta.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /tracks/{carrier}/{tracking_number}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `carrier` | string | yes | Carrier token as Shippo names it, e.g. "usps", "ups", "fedex", "dhl_express" (see the carrier field of shippo_list_carrier_accounts); "shippo" for test tracking numbers. |
| `tracking_number` | string | yes | The tracking number; with carrier "shippo": SHIPPO_PRE_TRANSIT, SHIPPO_TRANSIT, SHIPPO_DELIVERED, SHIPPO_RETURNED, SHIPPO_FAILURE or SHIPPO_UNKNOWN. |

### `shippo_register_tracking`

Register a tracking number for status updates, which Shippo then sends to the account's "track updated" webhook (set up in the Shippo dashboard). Returns the current tracking status.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /tracks`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `carrier` | string | yes | Carrier token, e.g. "usps", "dhl_express". |
| `tracking_number` | string | yes | The tracking number. |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note, up to 100 characters, sent back with each update. |

| `service_levels` | boolean | no | true to include each account's service levels. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `results` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 100. |

### `shippo_create_customs_item`

Create a customs item (one line of a customs declaration). Returns object_id.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /customs/items`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | yes | What it is, e.g. "Cotton T-shirt". |
| `quantity` | integer | yes | Number of pieces. |
| `net_weight` | string | yes | Total net weight of these pieces, e.g. "0.4". |
| `mass_unit` | `g` \| `kg` \| `lb` \| `oz` | yes | g, kg, lb or oz. |
| `value_amount` | string | yes | Total value of these pieces, e.g. "25.00". |
| `value_currency` | string | yes | Currency, e.g. "EUR". |
| `origin_country` | string | yes | Country of manufacture, ISO 2. |
| `tariff_number` | string | no | HS tariff number, e.g. "610910". |
| `sku_code` | string | no | Your SKU. |
| `eccn_ear99` | string | no | Export control classification (US exports). |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note. |

### `shippo_get_customs_item`

Read a customs item by object_id: description, quantity, weight, value, origin and tariff number.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /customs/items/{customs_item_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customs_item_id` | string | yes | The customs item object_id. |

### `shippo_create_customs_declaration`

Create a customs declaration for an international shipment from customs items. Pass its object_id as customs_declaration to shippo_create_shipment.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /customs/declarations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contents_type` | `DOCUMENTS` \| `GIFT` \| `SAMPLE` \| `MERCHANDISE` \| `HUMANITARIAN_DONATION` \| `RETURN_MERCHANDISE` \| `OTHER` | yes | DOCUMENTS, GIFT, SAMPLE, MERCHANDISE, HUMANITARIAN_DONATION, RETURN_MERCHANDISE or OTHER. |
| `contents_explanation` | string | no | Required when contents_type is OTHER. |
| `non_delivery_option` | `ABANDON` \| `RETURN` | yes | ABANDON or RETURN. |
| `certify` | boolean | yes | true: the signer certifies the information is correct (required). |
| `certify_signer` | string | yes | Name of the person certifying. |
| `items` | any[] | yes | Customs item object_ids (or item objects). |
| `incoterm` | `DDP` \| `DDU` \| `FCA` \| `DAP` \| `eDAP` | no | DDP, DDU, FCA, DAP or eDAP. |
| `eel_pfc` | string | no | US export exemption, e.g. NOEEI_30_37_a. |
| `invoice` | string | no | Commercial invoice number. |
| `exporter_identification` | object | no | e.g. {"eori_number": "DE123456789012345"}. |
| `metadata` | string | no | Your own note. |

### `shippo_get_customs_declaration`

Read a customs declaration by object_id, with its items, contents type, incoterm and signer.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /customs/declarations/{customs_declaration_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customs_declaration_id` | string | yes | The customs declaration object_id. |

List customs declarations, newest first, with contents type, items and certification details.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /customs/declarations`

|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `results` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 100. |

### `shippo_request_refund`

Void a purchased label and ask for its price back. The label can no longer be used. Only unused labels up to 90 days old; the money comes back after the carrier confirms (days to weeks). Confirm with the user first. Returns the refund with status QUEUED, PENDING, SUCCESS or ERROR.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /refunds`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction` | string | yes | The transaction (label) object_id. |
| `async` | boolean | no | false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again. |

### `shippo_list_refunds`

List label refunds with their status (QUEUED, PENDING, SUCCESS, ERROR) and the label they belong to.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /refunds/`

No parameters.

### `shippo_get_refund`

Read one label refund by object_id: status, label (transaction) and dates.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /refunds/{refund_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refund_id` | string | yes | The refund object_id. |

### `shippo_create_manifest`

Create a manifest (scan form) for a carrier pickup: one document listing the labels of one carrier account, ship date and origin address. Not available with a test key. Returns status and documents[] (URLs).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /manifests`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `carrier_account` | string | yes | Carrier account object_id. |
| `shipment_date` | string | yes | Ship date, ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-10-12T09:00:00Z". |
| `address_from` | string | yes | Origin address object_id (the same as on the labels). |
| `transactions` | string[] | no | Label (transaction) object_ids; all eligible labels of that day when omitted. |
| `async` | boolean | no | false (default here) waits for the result; true returns at once with status QUEUED, then read the object again. |

### `shippo_list_manifests`

List manifests (scan forms), newest first, with carrier account, ship date, status and documents.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /manifests`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `results` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 100. |

Read one manifest (scan form) with its status, the labels on it, document URLs and errors.

| `manifest_id` | string | yes | The manifest object_id. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Shippo** and enter `SHIPPO_API_TOKEN`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
